visual_identity.core_identity: A massive burrowing insect predator with a heavily armored segmented body, powerful mandibles, and digging legs.
visual_identity.silhouette: Long low insect body with broad armored thorax, tapered abdomen, six strong legs, and large front mandibles.
visual_identity.head_features: Armored insect head with oversized paired mandibles, small eyes, and short antennae.
visual_identity.body_shape: Three-part insect anatomy with six legs, plated thorax, segmented abdomen, and reinforced forelegs for digging.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly six insect legs; front pair are powerful digging limbs, remaining legs support a low grounded body. No wings or extra arachnid legs.
visual_identity.surface: Large chitin plates with simple seams and broad open coloring regions.

accuracy_checks: six legs are visible or clearly implied
armor plates are broad and colorable

known_failure_modes.symptom: ankheg gains eight legs or spider body
known_failure_modes.correction: restore exactly six insect legs and long segmented abdomen
restore armored insect head, mandibles, short antennae, and no wings
keep lower body visibly supported by earth or burrow opening

scene_identity.size_impression: Large insect whose armored body and digging limbs displace substantial earth and fill a broad burrow opening.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Low and supported on multiple legs, digging, half-emerged, or braced at a burrow edge.
behavior_style: guarding or crossing an earthen tunnel
